span.p: Loads map script and tiles, HTTPS

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Member
[Person, role USER]
Posts photos, follows, likes,
comments, chats, reports content

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Administrator
[Person, role ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN]
Moderates reports, manages accounts,
views the statistics dashboard

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Vivacon
[Software System]
Instagram-style social network:
accounts, posts, social graph,
realtime chat and notifications,
moderation, admin statistics

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Cloudinary
[External System, third-party SaaS]
Stores uploaded images,
returns public URLs

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Microsoft identity platform
[External System, Microsoft]
Issues OAuth2 access tokens
for the sending mailbox

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Microsoft Graph
[External System, Microsoft]
Sends verification and
new-device emails to members

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SightEngine
[External System, third-party SaaS]
Image moderation
(nudity, weapons, gore)

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Google Maps JS API
[External System, Google]
Renders a member's
login-location map
